sections.text_helper: Section 23.5.16 "GFXTIM absolute line counter register (GFXTIM_ALCR)" in chapter 23 (Graphic timer (GFXTIM)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1110.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x058
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 11:0 LINE[11:0]: Line number
Current value of the absolute line counter.
Note: This bitfield can only be written when the absolute line counter is disabled.

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.

fields.name: LINE[11:0]
fields.description: Line number Current value of the absolute line counter. Note: This bitfield can only be written when the absolute line counter is disabled.
